purpose: Teach: 年度末/社債/付け加える/構える/済ませる/終日/折っ/心がける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年度末の感慨、私もよく覚えている。
lines.en: I remember that feeling well when year-end came around.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. A slow unhurried pace. The voice of someone looking back. Gentle authority without weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社債に頼らない財務、目指しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're working toward a financial structure that doesn't rely on borrowing.
lines.style: Respectful and clear. Measured cadence. A statement of principle, not a recitation. Slightly formal in register — the younger man speaking carefully to his elder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 説明に、過去の教訓を付け加える視点、忘れるな。
lines.en: When you explain something, don't forget to add perspective from past lessons learned. That's the part people miss.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. A light emphasis on the instruction itself. Sparing with words — each one deliberate. The tone of teaching, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。長期視点で構える経営、続けます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll continue to manage with that long-term perspective.
lines.style: Steady and assured. A clear acceptance of what's expected. No hesitation — the voice of someone comfortable with responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: やるべきこと、計画通りに済ませるのが、責務だ。
lines.en: Getting done what needs to be done, on schedule, that's the responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A simple statement of principle. Pause slightly before the last clause — like he's reminding himself as much as the other man.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。終日、現場主義、貫いてまいります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we keep that commitment to putting staff first, every day on the ground.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not performative. A slight warmth underneath the formality — showing that this isn't just procedure, it matters to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 書類、ここを折って、印を押す、昔の流儀だ。
lines.en: Documents — fold it here, press your seal. That's how we did it.
lines.style: Calm, practical demonstration. A slow, almost nostalgic pace. Like he's showing something that's been done a thousand times before. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員第一、心がけるよう、徹底します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our people know they come first. That's how we'll do this.
lines.style: Respectful close. Warm undertone beneath the formality. The voice settling into agreement — not rushing the moment.
